Inline enum values:

### `gating_support`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `not_supported` | Gating not supported; host defines measurement time |
| 0x01 | `accuracy_le_2_ms` | Gating supported with time accuracy &lt;= 2 ms |
| 0x02 | `accuracy_le_20_ms` | Gating supported with time accuracy &lt;= 20 ms |
| 0x03 | `accuracy_gt_20_ms` | Gating supported with time accuracy &gt; 20 ms |

### `recovered_clock_for_generator_options`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `not_supported` | Recovered clock not supported for contra-directional pattern generator |
| 0x01 | `supported_without_loopback` | Supported without loopback |
| 0x02 | `supported_with_loopback` | Supported with loopback |
| 0x03 | `supported_with_and_without_loopback` | Supported with and without loopback |

### `host_prbs_generator_clock_source`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `internal_clock_all_lanes` | All lanes use Internal Clock |
| 0x1..0x8 | `reference_clock_media_lane_i` | All lanes use Reference Clock Media Lane i |
| 0x9..0xe | `reserved_9_e` | Reserved |
| 0x0F | `recovered_clock_per_media_lane_or_data_path` | Recovered clock per Media Lane or Data Path |

### `media_prbs_generator_clock_source`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `internal_clock_all_lanes` | All lanes use Internal Clock |
| 0x01 | `reference_clock_all_lanes` | All lanes use Reference Clock |
| 0x2..0x9 | `reference_clock_host_lane_i_minus_1` | All lanes use Reference Clock Host Lane i-1 |
| 0xa..0xe | `reserved_a_e` | Reserved |
| 0x0F | `recovered_clock_per_host_lane_or_data_path` | Recovered clock per Host Lane or Data Path |

### `measurement_time`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `ungated` | Ungated, counters accrue indefinitely |
| 0x01 | `gate_time_5_sec` | 5 second gate time |
| 0x02 | `gate_time_10_sec` | 10 second gate time |
| 0x03 | `gate_time_30_sec` | 30 second gate time |
| 0x04 | `gate_time_60_sec` | 60 second gate time |
| 0x05 | `gate_time_120_sec` | 120 second gate time |
| 0x06 | `gate_time_300_sec` | 300 second gate time |
| 0x07 | `custom` | Custom gate time |

### `update_period_select`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `one_second` | 1 second update interval |
| 0x01 | `five_seconds` | 5 second update interval |

| 0x01 | `internal_clock_all_lanes` | All lanes use Internal Clock |
| 0x02 | `reference_clock_all_lanes` | All lanes use Reference Clock |
| 0x03 | `reserved` | Reserved |
